name: ac
description: ac(8) connect-time accounting over /etc/wtmp. At the boot prompt the log holds the `~'/reboot record and the root/console login that is still open; ac closes the open session at `now' (its synthetic trailing `~' record) and credits root the boot-to-now interval. `ac -p' prints a per-user line for root and a grand total, both in hours to two decimals. Exercises the port's one FGX delta (ac.c:19, ctime() prototyped against its 24-bit far return) and upstream's own tbuf tty hashing, unchanged, over FGX's line names (ttyp0/ttyp1 at 5,056/5,057, ttyv1-3 at 5,531-5,533, console at TSIZE-1 = 6,241).
